text:
Alex H: Morning team — release train for Tuesday 09:00 UTC. Need lane claims and smoke owners. Plan: blue/green/canary buckets. Please reply with lane + smoke owner + rollback command ready (yes/no).
Priya R: I'll take Blue lane. Smoke owner: Priya. Rollback ready: yes. I'll watch first 30m. @Miguel S can you cover metrics?
Miguel S: On it. Will monitor p95/p99 and CPU. Have a dashboard open. Ping me if latency > 200ms.
Jin W: Taking Green lane. Smoke owner: Jin. Rollback ready: yes. I'll run smoke script after deploy: `./scripts/smoke-run.sh --env=staging` and then prod.
Sam T: Can take Canary bucket. Smoke owner: Sam. Rollback ready: partial — need one more hand for DB migration fallback. @Alex H can you be backup?
Alex H: Yep I can be backup for Canary rollback. For DB migration, Sam share the migration flag and rollback steps in thread.
Sam T: Migration flag: `db.migrate.v2=true`. Rollback: `db.migrate.v2=false` + `service restart`. Full steps pinned in deploy doc.
release-bot: Deploy window created: 2024-06-18T09:00:00Z -> 2024-06-18T11:00:00Z. Reminder set for owners.
Priya R: Quick note — can we do staggered starts? Blue at 09:00, Canary 09:15, Green 09:30.
Alex H: Good idea. Staggered schedule ok. Final plan:
```
09:00 Blue -> Priya (smoke)
09:15 Canary -> Sam (smoke) + Alex backup
09:30 Green -> Jin (smoke)
```
Alex H: Rollback signal: post to #incidents with `rollback:<lane>` and ping on-call. If any major errors, cut and roll.
Miguel S: Shared monitoring alerts:
- p95 latency > 200ms
- error rate > 1%
- CPU > 85% for 5m
I'll create a short-runbook and attach.
Jin W: I'll run the smoke checklist:
1) basic health endpoints
2) 10 sanity requests against /chat
3) latency + memory check
I'll post results under thread.
Sam T: Will need a 15min slot after Canary for PG backfill check. Requesting 09:30-09:45 reserve.
Alex H: noted. Sam you get 09:30-09:45 reserve. If Canary passes earlier we can compress.
Priya R: All clear from my side. I'll post a `:thumbsup:` reaction when Blue smoke is green.
Alex H: Thanks all — leaving this thread open for any pre-deploy adjustments. Ping me directly if you need help. :rocket:
